sources.title: Kilo Code README
sources.locator: README.md Installation, Agents, What it does, Autonomous Mode, License, FAQ
sources.finding: Open-source agent for VS Code, JetBrains and CLI; 500+ models at provider rates; Code/Plan/Ask/Debug agents; kilo run --auto for CI; Cloud Agent and Code Reviews at app.kilo.ai; MIT; CLI is a fork of OpenCode; main not accepting new features (v2 branch).

sources.title: MIT license
sources.finding: MIT license text at repository root covering the monorepo.

sources.title: Repository agent guide
sources.finding: All products are clients of the CLI runtime (packages/opencode); each client spawns or connects to kilo serve over HTTP and SSE using @kilocode/sdk. Agent Manager is a feature of the VS Code extension with git worktree isolation.

sources.title: Generated CLI command table
sources.finding: Commands: tui, run, serve, attach, acp, mcp, auth, agent, models, stats, export, import, github, pr, session, remote, daemon, cloud, db, config, plugin.

sources.title: Agent Manager docs
sources.locator: Orchestration model table; task subagents; Kilo Swarm
sources.finding: Parallel worktree-isolated sessions in VS Code; task subagents (foreground/background, resume, nesting limits); Kilo Swarm shared board; agent_manager tool to prompt or stop sessions.

sources.title: agent_manager tool description
sources.finding: Tool lets an agent list, prompt, stop, move and answer questions for Agent Manager sessions, with replyTo request IDs.

sources.title: Agent Manager worktree manager
sources.finding: Creates and manages git worktrees per Agent Manager session with setup scripts and base-branch handling.

sources.title: Kilo Swarm shared board
sources.finding: Shared agent board is on by default (shared_agent_board=false disables); board_post and board_read exchange messages between a main session and task descendants.

sources.title: Wakeup and cron scheduler
sources.locator: packages/opencode/src/kilocode/wakeup/schema.ts (MIN_DELAY_MS 10s, MAX_HORIZON 7 days, MAX_PER_SESSION 10, CRON_TTL 7 days), cron.ts (min interval 60s)
sources.finding: Agent tools schedule_wakeup, cron_create/list/delete resume a session on a future time or 5-field cron schedule; bounded per session; persisted in the local database.

sources.title: kilo serve password authentication
sources.finding: HTTP basic credentials from KILO_SERVER_PASSWORD (username default kilo) gate the server when set.

sources.title: Sandboxing docs
sources.locator: Enable the sandbox; config keys; when to use
sources.finding: OS-level write and network confinement for agent tools on macOS and Linux (not Windows); disabled by default; reads unrestricted; refuses to run if policy cannot be enforced; project config can only tighten.

sources.title: Sandbox backends
sources.finding: macOS seatbelt and Linux bubblewrap backends with network relay and mutation workers.

sources.title: Agent permissions docs
sources.finding: allow/ask/deny per tool with glob patterns, last match wins, per-agent frontmatter; global defaults in kilo.jsonc.

sources.title: Cost controls and usage safeguards
sources.locator: Doom loop protection; per-tool approval; account-level controls
sources.finding: doom_loop permission (default ask) pauses repeated failure cycles; per-tool approvals; organization usage controls; no per-session hard spend cap described in the extracted section.

sources.title: Checkpoints docs
sources.finding: Snapshots in a dedicated git repo outside the project, on by default; machine-wide optional session auto-cleanup (default 30 days, off).

sources.title: Session goals docs
sources.locator: Starting a goal; Goal controls; statuses
sources.finding: /goal keeps one objective across turns with pause/resume/clear; agent goal tool; statuses active/paused/blocked/complete.

sources.title: Memory docs
sources.locator: What memory stores; Enable memory; auto-save
sources.finding: Opt-in per-project memory (project.md, environment.md, corrections.md, session digests) stored under the global data dir; auto-save sends redacted turn context to the model provider.

sources.title: Sessions and sharing docs
sources.locator: What a session keeps; Resume on another device; Share a session
sources.finding: Local sessions stay on the machine; account-backed cloud sessions are private by default with optional read-only share links; copy-link resume on other devices.

sources.title: Mobile apps docs
sources.locator: What you can do; App actions
sources.finding: iOS and Android apps view and manage sessions (including remote CLI/extension sessions), spawn Cloud Agents, queue follow-ups, review PRs, shortcuts and notifications.

sources.title: Cloud Agent docs
sources.locator: Prerequisites; Cost; Choosing where sessions run
sources.finding: Browser-based agents running in vendor sandboxes against GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket repos with auto commit/push options; per-second compute ($0.60 to $1.20/hour) billed from the same credit balance; $5 minimum balance to launch.

sources.title: Kilo Connect docs
sources.finding: Slack (@Kilo), GitHub (@kilocode-bot), Linear (@kilo) and DoltHub entry points configured from app.kilo.ai Integrations.

sources.title: Gas Town by Kilo concepts
sources.finding: Hosted orchestration: a conversational mayor coordinator, polecat coding agents in separate git worktrees, a refinery review agent; beads have lifecycle open/in_progress/in_review/closed/failed; convoys are dependency DAGs; reconciler dispatches only when dependencies are met.

sources.title: About plans
sources.finding: Teams $15 per user per month with no inference markup; Enterprise adds model/provider limits, audit logs, SSO/OIDC/SCIM, SLA; no credits included.

sources.title: SSO docs
sources.finding: Enterprise SSO through WorkOS requested via a form; IdP-initiated login not supported.

sources.title: Audit logs docs
sources.finding: Owner-visible searchable log of organization actions (logins, invites, role changes, settings, credits, custom modes, SSO).

sources.title: ChatGPT subscriptions with Kilo
sources.locator: Connect your subscription; connect directly in VS Code or the CLI
sources.finding: ChatGPT Go/Plus/Pro subscriptions can serve supported OpenAI models through Kilo (BYOK on the Gateway or directly in VS Code/CLI) with no Kilo credits.

sources.title: Using Kilo for free

sources.finding: Auto Free routes to free models (some providers log prompts); free models, BYOK and local models available.

sources.title: Settings reference
sources.finding: Telemetry enabled by default; experimental.openTelemetry=false in kilo.jsonc opts out; OTLP export when OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is set.

sources.title: Kilo CLI privacy policy
sources.finding: Code, prompts and files go to the chosen model provider; API keys stored locally; Kilo says it does not store prompts or code in the CLI; local models avoid third parties.

sources.title: Gateway usage and billing
sources.finding: Kilo Gateway meters usage per request against account credits at provider rates.

sources.title: AI providers index

sources.title: Memory runtime

sources.title: Codebase indexing

sources.title: Wakeup scheduler behavior
sources.finding: A missed cron window is skipped rather than replayed and the claim arms the next window; deterministic per-task jitter (up to 15s) is clamped so it never passes expiry; file-lock contention retries with backoff; no failed-run retry policy was found.
